verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs describe it as a unified platform covering corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel and bill pay, plus a business banking account, all exposed through matching APIs: Payments (ACH, wires, checks), Transactions/accounts, Expenses and Budgets. That covers the spend, bill-pay and banking consolidation the story asks for. Community reports add real caveats for founders: Brex exited the small-business market, imposed higher cash minimums on non-VC-backed companies, rejected some bank-account applications, and in one case required an external business bank account at signup. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that one platform actually replaces separate banking and bill-pay tools, and clear eligibility for non-VC-backed or small founders.
